annotations.title: Add a note to a candidate

description:
[Candidates] Add a note to a candidate (candidate_id) or to one result (result_id), visible to the team or private to you, optionally mentioning colleagues (each mention gets one e-mail). Notes cannot be changed or deleted through this tool.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

candidate_id.description: Candidate id (profile_interview.id): a note on the candidate.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

mention_profile_ids.description: Colleagues to mention (profile.id), at most 20; each gets an e-mail with the note (switch mentions).

result_id.description: Interview result id (interview_result.id): a note on that result.

visibility.description: team (default): the company sees it; private: only you (switch private_notes).

name: add_candidate_note
title: Add a note to a candidate
